comment: Canonical React Native dependency patches for the family. ONE mechanism: bun `patchedDependencies` (filenames name@version.patch, package-relative paths, applied by `bun install`). No patch-package anywhere. scripts/sync_rn_patches.sh copies each canonical file into its consumers' patches/ dir so every project stays byte-identical; each consumer must also declare the patch in its package.json patchedDependencies. Patches stay vendored per-project because bun patchedDependencies and CI `bun install --frozen-lockfile` both need the file present -- this is a single source of truth plus a sync step.

patches.why: Native Swift fix in ios/TabViewImpl.swift (compile-level; cannot be swizzled). Must stay until fixed upstream in a release the family adopts.

C++ ReactCommon renderer fixes (ShadowNode/ShadowNodeFamily/UIManager nativeProps_DEPRECATED mutex) + Modal sheet + View recycle hover-reset (compile-level; cannot be swizzled). Re-ported from 0.81.9 on 2026-10-27; nil-class codegen hunk removed 2026-10-28 (now handled by @sudobility/components-rn@1.0.133's runtime swizzle). Validated by a macOS xcodebuild. Renderer fixes upstreamed as microsoft/react-native-macos#3155.
Adds macOS support to the podspec + source (compile-level; still :ios-only upstream at 0.13.6). Music family only.

Windows RNSVG Fabric fixes only: Svg.tsx pushes inherited presentation attributes onto descendants (the Windows renderer does not inherit a group's fill/stroke, so outline icons drew solid) + the per-element-redraw and leaked-document-per-redraw fixes in windows/RNSVG/Fabric. The macOS hunks from the old patch are gone -- react-native-svg 15.16 ships them upstream (NSImage signature, RNSVGSvgView wantsUpdateLayer, and an NSImage.CGImage category in apple/RNSVGUIKit.h). Consumers are the svg+Windows apps that carried the patch.
macOS support (compile-level): cross-platform RNWGUIKit header, AppKit casing + CAMetalLayer, MetalView isFlipped for top-left gesture origin. Still needed at 0.19.2. music_app_rn-webgpu-spike only.

obsolete.comment: Upstream has absorbed these; do not carry them.
obsolete.@shopify/react-native-skia (macOS Metal): Upstream at skia >= 2.13; dropped when music moved to 2.13.0.
obsolete.react-native-svg (macOS: NSImage signatu: Upstream in react-native-svg 15.16.0 (incl. the NSImage.CGImage category in apple/RNSVGUIKit.h); removed from the svg patch, which is now Windows-only.
obsolete.react-native-safe-area-context+5.6.2: 5.6.2 ships the Windows provider upstream; removed from music.

notes.mechanism: Standardized on bun patchedDependencies on 2026-10-28 (was mixed with patch-package in the music apps and svgr). patch-package, its postinstall call, and scripts/unshare-patched-files.cjs were removed from those projects.
notes.music_app_rn-webgpu-spike: On branch spike/webgpu-macos; not in sudobility's deploy list. Pre-existing non-RN WIP: three/webgpu has no shipped types, 2 unit tests fail.
